content.interpretation: Only the record's own verdicts are source-supported, and interpretation plus support explanations remain semantically unassessed. Supported by exact values in this historical Stage336 'proposal-build' record (execution_id 494deb38d6374deb8f741e96f2430826, result_type "free_reach", world frame): the run is recorded as complete and solver/force-clean (complete=true, valid_complete_execution=true, solver_error_count=0, force_bound_violation_n=0.0, all six tendon tensions within limit_n 8.0 N); it ended with tip error 0.06672099201814737 m and tip speed 0.16436452055040404 m/s, with per-axis signed errors [-0.05036794349396048, 0.007544922777855512, 0.043102612268296286] that are consistent with the declared convention "actual_tip minus target" against target [0.29, 0.035, 0.19]; its sampled holding/settling check is an explicit failure (passed=false, max_error_m 0.06672099201814737 m vs position_limit_m 0.01 m, max_speed_m_s 0.20679063000945364 m/s vs speed_limit_m_s 0.02 m/s over window_s 0.05), and the record itself denies a continuous-time guarantee; task_accepted=false is recorded for the same run. What is NOT supported: any claim of target reach within the stated limits, and any distinct "reach" judgment at all — no reach criterion, tolerance or reach verdict field exists in the inspected source, so reach success is unknown here rather than measured-failed. Also unsupported: any generalization from the one-step agreement statistics (aligned_count 35, max 0.006041094970688899 m) to trajectory-level tracking, because the record itself scopes them to first-step matches with "no future-plan replay comparison". Purely descriptive coincidences/limitations to carry alongside, without causal reading: sampled max_error equals the terminal error exactly (so the windowed maximum carries no independent information beyond the ending value in what is recorded), and that 0.05 s window aggregate is reported while simulated_duration_s is 0.35 and control_period_s is 0.01. Internal tension worth flagging: converged_updates=0 with deadline_misses=35 (one per control update) and accepted_noninitialization_plans=0 while initialization_selected=35, yet the run is still recorded complete and valid — I do not diagnose a dominant cause for these facts. Scope limits: the authorized directory contained exactly one entry, this artifact, which I read in full across its 36 root fields; the evaluation, simulation, configuration, report and prediction-evidence artifacts referenced inside it were not in scope and were not read, so the criteria definitions behind passed, task_accepted and the plan counters are unknown. This old Stage336 result is not attributed to any later promoted candidate.
